questions: Did you see the story about saffron research at Colorado State?

conversation_starters.description: Colorado's hot, dry summers and cold winters can make growing crops challenging. But researchers at Colorado State University are studying whether those same conditions could make the state an ideal place to grow one of the world's most valuable spices: saffron.
